curriculum: one old14 material panel in the common parent only;4representative forms before/after in each branch
A one paired/opposite/omitted explicit lesson, followed by2common-reader queries
B first common-reader query before B teaching (initial transfer, not meta-learning)
B three signed paired lessons, each followed by2common-reader queries; do not stop early or add lessons
B functional use with datum23/contextgamma via the same fixed sign transduction
A post-course common-reader query and final old14 material panel
plan.dose_limit: Omitted A teacher has fewer material inputs; cue count/age/query count are matched and actual admission/rejection must be reported. No claim of perfectly equal material dose.
plan.equality_contract: Exact encoded and decoded complete snapshot bytes + physical fields + common loaded metadata inventories; no branch-specific experience before the guard
plan.evidence_persistence: Each completed lesson/query/use is emitted through on_event before the next material call; partial failed future is saved by the owner runner.

geometry.scope: Design geometry only. Lack of static overlap does not establish dynamic isolation or vacancy.

plan.prefix: A complete APD02 parent copy after one common old14 panel, then exactly one preparation of both empty generic slots; no taught A/B content.
plan.sampling_limit: Per-branch4forms cover two arithmetic signs and two prepared functional requests, not full14retention. Only the prefix has an old14panel; MAIN final requires its own full panel.
plan.scope: Six branches share a prefix, not six independent learners. A related/opposite sign can produce transfer or interference; an initial advantage alone does not demonstrate learning-to-learn.
